source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
      [PERSON_NUMBER] as xgi_externalid
  --  ,[SSN_ENCRYPTED] as xg_ssntext
      ,cast([SSN_ENCRYPTED] as varchar(11)) as xg_ssntext
      ,[FIRST_NAME] as firstname
      ,[MIDDLE_NAME] as middlename
      ,[LAST_NAME] as  lastname
      ,[SUFFIX] as suffix
      ,[DATE_OF_BIRTH]as xgi_dateofbirth
      ,[DATE_OF_DEATH] as xg_dateofdeath
      ,[PRIMARY_PHONE] as mobilephone
      ,[FRAME_CREATED_DATE] as overriddencreatedon
      ,[FRAME_MODIFIED_DATE] as xgi_overridemodifieddate
      ,EMAIL_ADDRESS as emailaddress1
      ,case
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENDER_CODE))) IN ('M','MALE') THEN 1
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENDER_CODE))) IN ('F','FEMALE') THEN 2
       else NULL
       end as gendercode
     , CAST('fa1abe76-6b34-ef11-8409-6045bdd63e76' AS uniqueidentifier) AS OwnerId
   ,'systemuser' AS OwnerIdType
 ,  CAST('85dae142-0ad8-ef11-8ee9-000d3a185ee5' AS uniqueidentifier) AS parentcustomerid
  , 'account'         AS parentcustomeridType
  FROM [STAGING].[FRAME_PERSON]
